01 — About

I am an electrical engineer and researcher passionate about pushing the boundaries of hardware design, embedded systems, and applied machine learning. I recently completed my M.S. in Electrical Engineering at UAH with a perfect 4.0 GPA.

My research focuses on efficient image compression and deduplication using deep learning, with applications to medical imaging datasets such as malaria-infected erythrocytes. I also have hands-on experience in VLSI/CMOS circuit design, PCB development, and FPGA-based embedded systems.

Research interests:

Computer Architecture Embedded Systems VLSI Design ML Image Compression FPGA CMOS Circuit Design PCB Design Deep Learning

06 — Projects
⚡
Three-Stage Miller-Compensated CMOS Op-Amp (180 nm)

Designed and simulated a high-performance three-stage CMOS op-amp in LTspice using 180 nm bulk CMOS PTM BSIM3v3 models. Achieved 98.75 dB open-loop gain, 108.78 dB CMRR, 68.09° phase margin, and 2.58 V/µs slew rate.

LTspice180nm CMOSPMOS folded-cascodeClass-AB buffer

PCB Design — ESP32 USB-C using Altium Designer

Full PCB design flow including schematic capture, custom footprints, DRC checks, Gerber file generation, BOM, and Pick & Place file for an ESP32 with USB-C integration.
